QuestInfo.name: The Rising Fanatic!
QuestInfo.0: Your favorite star, Lilin, has something to say to you... Wonder if this is something about her fan club?
QuestInfo.1: Wow! If you help Lilin with her Rising Star training 30 times or more, you can be her official crazed fan! You need to work really hard!
QuestInfo.2: You are an official Lilin fanatic! The green balloon says it all!

0.0: Hello #b#h0##k. I am #bLilin#k, and I want to contend for the Maple Rising Star. Thank you for becoming a member of my fan club and helping me out. If you work diligently during the contest, I will accept you as my #rCrazy Fan#k. Are you interested?

yes.0: In preparation for the Maple Rising Star Contest, if you can help me complete my training for singing, instruments, dancing, appearance, fame, and reputation 30 times each, then I will consider you my official crazy fan.
yes.1: You can start each training type by clicking on the event star, or by talking to Gaga, Cassandra or the Maple Admin. As for your activity history with the fan club, check the #r7th Anniversary Diary#k you get from Cassandra. Okay, let's get this done!

no.0: Oh, I guess this was too soon for you... Maybe we can talk again later.

quest.0: I don't think you're quite active enough in the fan club. Maybe if you put more effort in...
